name: waiver-realism-v1
responds_to: C02-codex BLOCK at review commit d50f757 (corrections 1-4)
supersedes: nothing — the C02 implementation's decision rule was implemented without a frozen manifest; this manifest is preregistered BEFORE the C02A decision-rule change and rewrites no existing manifest
hypotheses: A roster-wide, slot-eligibility-aware add/drop rule removes observable false negatives (a better free body blocked only by nominal position) without breaking K/DST streaming or the bench-insurance contrast.
Making transaction cost a decision gate (not only a season accounting charge) prevents claims whose expected remaining-horizon improvement cannot repay their cost.
A point-in-time believed projection is sufficient to acquire a genuine in-season breakout whose preseason prior was low.

decision_rule.believed_projection: per-week shrunk forecast (kappa*preseason_per_game + observed_sum) / (kappa + observed_games), computed only from weeks strictly before the decision — unchanged from C02
decision_rule.cost_units: fantasy points, identical units to started_points and to the per-week believed projection times weeks
decision_rule.remaining_horizon_conversion: expected improvement of a claim decided after week w (0-based, for week w+1 onward) = per-week believed gain x weeks_left, where weeks_left = weeks - 1 - w
decision_rule.upside_gain: per-week believed gain of a swap = proj[add] - proj[drop]
decision_rule.emergency_gain: per-week believed gain of filling an otherwise-empty starting slot = proj[add] (the alternative is a 0-point hole)
decision_rule.decision_threshold: a claim executes only if gain_per_week x weeks_left > waiver_cost (STRICT inequality). Equal-to-cost and below-cost claims must not execute.
decision_rule.relative_margin: the C02 anti-churn gate is RETAINED for upside claims and frozen here: proj[add] > proj[drop] x (1 + upgrade_margin), default upgrade_margin = 0.15 (relative per-week projection margin, dimensionless; it is NOT the per-claim cost and never was the cost)
decision_rule.boundary_semantics: strict '>' on the cost gate; strict '>' on the margin gate; ties never transact
decision_rule.feasibility: an add is feasible only if the incoming body is eligible for at least one of the league's actual lineup slots (slot_positions over the row's starting_slots)
decision_rule.drop_selection: drop candidates are squad bodies sharing at least one eligible slot with the incoming body (role space; FLEX/OP overlap makes cross-position swaps legal). Nonstarters in that role space are preferred, lowest believed projection first (the lowest forward-looking nonstarter opportunity cost); only when the role space contains no nonstarter may a started body be replaced - which is exactly K/DST streaming. Identical nominal positions are NOT required.
decision_rule.no_slots_fallback: when a caller provides no slot template, the role space is unconstrained and the drop candidate is the lowest-believed-projection body (reviewer probe semantics)
decision_rule.accounting: waiver_cost remains charged ONCE per executed claim at season aggregation into per_season/started_points (the C02 documented accounting penalty). The decision gate is a comparison, not a second charge - no double-charging. H2H and playoff/championship proxy outcomes stay on-field (cost-free), as reconciled in C02-claude.md and to be reconciled in the promotion manifest by its owner.

configs.note: waiver_cost default 0.0 keeps the cost gate inert by default (gain > 0 required); non-zero costs are experiment-arm inputs, not tuned production constants

metrics: started_points (net of accounting cost) and per_season paired samples
emergency_adds / upside_adds counters (must reconcile to waiver_adds)
acceptance_tests: cross-position FLEX substitution: a low nonstarter RB is replaced by a materially better free TE when both are FLEX-eligible
cost boundary: just-below-cost executes is FORBIDDEN; equal-to-cost is FORBIDDEN; just-above-cost executes
in-season breakout: a free agent with a LOW preseason prior and high realized weeks is acquired once point-in-time observations make it actionable, and is NOT acquired in a no-breakout control
reviewer probe engine/tests/test_v6_c02_decision_adversarial.py passes against production code
preserved: shared pool, reverse priority, weekly/season caps, emergency/upside distinction, K/DST streaming, determinism, leakage guard, paired samples, bench-insurance contrast

failure_interpretation.deterministic_failure: BLOCK_C02A — any acceptance test failure or determinism/leakage regression blocks
failure_interpretation.behavioral_ambiguity: PRESERVE_ACCEPTED_C02_BEHAVIOR — where the corrected rule is ambiguous, the C02-accepted behavior (proven items in C02-codex) is the authority
failure_interpretation.calibration: OUT_OF_SCOPE — no player-value coefficient may change and no failed calibration threshold may be reinterpreted under this manifest
